page.overview:
Who is Vaelus?

is an elven paladin played by Ashley Johnson in Campaign Four.

Vaelus is extremely tall, and she has lavender skin with visible facial scarring of magical origin that spread across her body (with their origin being something the elf prefers not to explain outloud). Episode 2 Discussing Up To C4E18|48:41}} Episode 2 Discussing Up To C4E18|1:21:58}} She dresses in deep obsidian, including snug black leather chest armor and robes, with a black hood and pale white lace that goes to the top of her throat. She carries a long chain with a bladed censer that emits smoke. She wears a veil of mourning that appears to be made of chainmail. Ashley Johnson described her as a "nun assassin". Campaign 4 Ep 1-4 Recap]" | vod=https://youtu.be/hdLPwuKMlIY | 14:19}}

Vaelus has a cold and calm demeanor. She was driven by her goal to find the Stone of Nightsong but she could show patience in order to obtain what she wanted. Finding and protecting every relic of Sylandri is very important to her. The feelings that she has for the lost goddess are what drives her. She is drawn to Occtis's magic because he has returned from the dead. Campaign 4 Ep 1-4 Recap]" | vod=https://youtu.be/hdLPwuKMlIY | 15:07}} She generally struggles trusting other people. Episode 2 Discussing Up To C4E18|18:48}}

Vaelus was once a very happy and joyful elf who spent her time in celebrations and activities with her family, honoring their creator goddess, Sylandri. Only a few years before her 50th birthday she was somewhat conflicted about finding her purpose honoring the Green Mother, since she was devout but couldn't remember the prayers, and found more enjoyment in climbing trees than in trying to memorize them. In the Shapers' War, seventy years before Campaign Four, Vaelus watched the death of the last of the Shapers; when the Last Arrow was shot, her sister Maywyn was nearby and was distracted by the light of the weapon, causing her to be killed by a battleaxe in front of Vaelus. Afterwards, she spent decades of mourning and prayer with the Sisters of Sylandri, occasionally fighting the undead alongside them. About a decade before the war Vaelus had traveled across Pasitar at least once, and did so again when she was a Sister of Sylandri briefly visiting the Eternal Night before and after its creation. In her journeys she learned about the other Shapers out of curiosity.
